verdict: Background Intelligent Transfer Service error during content transfer. BITS is how the MECM client moves bytes between itself and the DP.
fix: Restart BITS (`Restart-Service BITS`). Inspect stuck jobs: `Get-BitsTransfer -AllUsers | Format-Table DisplayName,JobState,BytesTotal,BytesTransferred`. If jobs are stuck in `TransientError`, examine `%windir%\ccmcache\` permissions (the SYSTEM account must have full control). If a proxy is in path, ensure it is not stripping Range headers or rewriting HTTP responses.
